items:
Wear your safety and healthy equipment as safety helmet, safety shoes, breathing mask, safety glass 
 ... etc.

Close the isolating 
 valves for water and steam this drum level sight glass.

Complete 
 maintenance tool set.

Cleaning 
 fluid, manual puller

Torque 
 wrench. .
Check any leakage from the level glass valves
Check any leakage from the Mecca (plastic strips).
Shut gauge valve and gage line valves. Open drain valve.
Determine port cap screws (10) and remove. (Hex wench size 5/16" ).

Remove cover (2) with its spring cone or cones (4), washer (5) and cushion 
 gasket (6) held in place by retaining spring (8). Discard the gasket.

Remove old glass mica-gasket clip ring assembly (7, 11, 9, and 3), held in 
 retaining spring

Clean gasket sealing surface in the gage body by use of a stainless steel wire 
 brush (Yarway part no. 301160) attached to an electric drill. Avoid damaging 
 the seating surface.

Clean contact surfaces of cover, gage bode and washer (5). Remove traces of 
 cushion gasket (6) that may be adhering to washer for cleaning. Inspect 
 condition of spring cones, discard and replace if damaged or corroded.

Apply a light coating of high temperature anti-seize thread compound to cap 
 screw threads. Avoid any build-up of anti-seize compound on all threaded 
 surfaces, internal or external.
Place spring cone or cones (4), correctly oriented, into cover.
Place flat washer (5) on top of spring cone or cones.
Reinstall retaining spring (8) Locate in groove in cover.
Place cushion gasket (60 on top of flat washer.

Insert repair port, glass-mica-sealing gasket-clip ring, as an assembly into 
 the retaining spring. The retaining spring holds the repair port in the cover 
 assembly. Be sure sealing gasket is firmly held in place by clip ring. To 
 prevent premature failure, keep moisture from entering between the mica and 
 the glass.

Reinstall cover assembly with vent hole horizontal and away from normal 
 access. Tighten cap screws uniformly using hex wrench (do not use power 
 wrenching) until metal to metal contact is made between cover and body. 
 Further tightening may damage cape caps screws and body.

It is recommended that each port be repaired completely before proceeding with 
 another.
Do not touch glass and mica with fingers or dirty clothes.

It is recommended to change the spring cones (part 4) at every second glass 
 renewal.

Replacement parts are furnished as repair port assembly in a package unit of 
 five items of glass (3), mica (9), sealing gasket (11), held together in clip 
 ring (7), plus cushion gasket (6). This assembly insures greater ease of 
 maintenance. Cleanliness of parts is most important, use care to maintain 
 cleanliness.

When ordering parts, identity the gage serial number of figure number in order 
 that correct repair parts are furnished.
